# BuyWise Israel

> Property discovery platform built for English-speaking international buyers exploring Israeli real estate. Compare 30+ markets, calculate purchase taxes and total acquisition costs, browse verified listings, and connect with vetted agents — all in English.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of BuyWise Israel and featured markets.
- [Listings](/listings): Search apartments and homes for sale across Israel.
- [Buy](/buy): Properties for sale, filtered by price, city, and bedrooms.
- [Rent](/rent): Rental properties across Israeli cities.
- [Projects](/projects): New construction developments and pre-sale opportunities.
- [Areas](/areas): Market data for 30+ Israeli cities and neighborhoods.
- [Map](/map): Interactive map search of properties and projects.
- [Tools](/tools): Mortgage, purchase tax, affordability, true-cost, and rent-vs-buy calculators.
- [Guides](/guides): Long-form guides covering buying in Israel, taxes, mortgages, and more.
- [Glossary](/glossary): Hebrew real-estate terms translated and explained.
- [Blog](/blog): Editorial posts on Israeli property markets and buyer journeys.
- [Agencies](/agencies): Directory of verified Israeli real-estate agencies.
- [Professionals](/professionals): Vetted lawyers, mortgage advisors, and inspectors.
- [About](/about): Our principles and how BuyWise works.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the BuyWise team.

## Calculators

- [Purchase Tax Calculator](/tools?tool=totalcost): Israeli mas rechisha brackets for residents and non-residents.
- [Mortgage Calculator](/tools?tool=mortgage): Bank of Israel-compliant LTV/PTI mortgage estimates.
- [Affordability Calculator](/tools?tool=affordability): How much property you can afford in NIS.
- [Rent vs Buy](/tools?tool=rentvsbuy): Net wealth comparison over time.
